caption:
Sayulita eats well. 🌮✨

From hole-in-the-wall taco stands to beachfront ceviche, rooftop mezcal bars to fresh juice spots at the market — the food scene here punches way above its weight for a small surf town.

A few favorites you need to hit:
🐟 Fresh seafood tostadas at the market
🌮 Al pastor tacos at midnight (trust us)
🥑 Açaí bowls post-surf
🍹 Mezcal negroni watching the sun go down
☕ Strong coffee before paddling out

Sayulita runs on flavor. Come hungry.

📍 Sayulita, Nayarit, México
